components.name: Beyond Borders heading
components.description: Solid, uppercase two-line heading inherited from the dark Kanit portfolio.
components.css: .ds-global-heading { margin:0; color:var(--mist); font-family:var(--font-kanit), Kanit, sans-serif; font-size:clamp(3.5rem,7.8vw,6rem); font-weight:900; line-height:0.9; letter-spacing:-0.035em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Certificate link
components.description: Underlined evidence link with visible keyboard focus and a 44px minimum target.
components.html: View exchange certificate
components.css: .ds-global-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; min-height:44px; font-family:var(--font-kanit), Kanit, sans-serif; font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--mist); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:5px; text-decoration-color:#778793; transition:color 180ms ease; } .ds-global-link:hover { color:#ffffff; } .ds-global-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--mist); outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview: This records the completed Beyond Borders section within the existing portfolio. Large, solid lettering and original exchange photographs carry the section; concise stories sit directly on a dark surface. This is a scoped implementation record, not a redesign specification for other sections.
keyCharacteristics: Flat story rows and underlined evidence links.
dos: Do preserve the incumbent dark palette and Kanit typography when extending this section.
Do retain original photographs, source-backed claims, and working certificate links.
Do keep the heading solid and the mobile reading order intact.
donts: Don't treat this scoped record as authorization to restyle unrelated sections.
